name: S-Hock dataset
description: A dataset and benchmark for analyzing spectator crowds in images or video for tasks like detection and crowd behavior analysis.
evaluation_method: MAE / MSE for crowd counting; mAP / precision-recall for detection/localization; task-specific metrics for behavior analysis
reputation: Moderately cited dataset for spectator crowd analysis and crowd behavior research, though less widely used than some larger crowd datasets.
notes: Vision benchmark (images/videos) with moderate dataset size; potential domain shift vs. real-world stadiums; annotations and tasks vary (counting vs detection), so reported metrics are task-dependent; not an LLM benchmark.
